title: Elegant pop-ups: names, speech, prompts and notices that make sense
brief: OWNER (Nov 3, 9 AM PT, on his iPhone): "When I was at the cafe, it froze. You have to check these menus, and sometimes what's happening gets in the way. I think we can have pop-ups happening, with the names and stuff, but it needs to come in a more elegant way. Sometimes the bubbles and stuff are all over the place, getting... don't make a lot of sense." Build ONE calm, Animal-Crossing-like presentation layer for everything that pops up over the world, replacing today's scattered floating labels, bubbles and toasts. CORE: (1) PLACE NAMES: no more permanent floating labels over every building. Show a small elegant name card (paper style from Addendum S, serif title + one-line subtitle like 'Drizzle & Bean Cafe, open till 7') that fades in at the top centre for ~2.5 s when the walker arrives in front of a place or enters an area, or when Mocha arrives somewhere in follow mode; then fades out. Optional faint world label only for the place directly in front of the walker within ~6 units. The big map keeps all names. (2) SPEECH: one consistent bubble style anchored to the speaker's head with a little tail, max 2 short lines (longer text pages with a tap), never overlapping the HUD or each other: at most ONE world bubble at a time near the camera focus (Mocha first, then whoever is talking to you, then the nearest NPC); other NPC chatter is queued or dropped, never stacked; bubbles from characters off-screen or behind walls are not shown (Mocha off-screen uses the existing edge chip, with his line inside it). Gentle scale+fade in/out (180 ms), no jumping around: bubbles follow the head smoothly and clamp to safe screen bands. (3) PROMPTS: a single context button above the right-thumb area ('Talk to Juniper', 'Enter', 'Sit', 'Shop') that appears only when facing something interactable, with the same paper style; no duplicate pills. (4) NOTICES: one notice lane (top centre under the status pill) with a queue: one at a time, 2.5 s each, merged when similar ('+24 coins' instead of three toasts), rate-limited (catalog milestones etc.), tap to dismiss; never covering the stick, the look area, cards or sheets. (5) QUIET WHILE BUSY: while any card, sheet, menu, talk card, Your Look, decorate or the map is open, world bubbles/names/notices pause and queue (except the speaker you are talking to), and resume calmly after. (6) THE CAFE FREEZE: reproduce what the owner hit at the cafe on a throttled phone (CDP CPU throttle 4x, 393x852): enter, walk to the counter, talk to Juniper, open the item card / see everything / buy, sit at a table, while NPC chatter and Mocha are around; fix every main-thread stall over 100 ms and every tap that does nothing (including elements intercepting taps). STRETCH: subtle sound ticks for name cards and notices; a 'Show place names' setting (Auto / Always / Off).
acceptance: No permanent world labels in walk or follow mode; a name card appears within 300 ms of arriving at a place and fades by ~3 s; the map still lists all names.

At most one world speech bubble is visible at a time in a 5-minute soak in Lantern Square with chatty NPCs; no bubble ever overlaps the HUD bands or another bubble (sampled every 100 ms) in portrait, landscape, Duo and desktop.
Opening any card/sheet/menu pauses world bubbles, names and notices (queue), and they resume after it closes.
Notices: three coin events within 1 s produce one merged notice; never more than one notice visible; none overlap the stick or look areas.
The context button shows only when facing an interactable within range and performs the action; no duplicate 'Talk to' pills.
Cafe flow on a 4x-throttled 393x852 phone: no long task over 100 ms during enter, talk, item card, see everything, buy, sit; every tap responds within 150 ms.
smoke 15 and 1 OK; test-B23 (talk), test-B25 (shopping), test-controls/test-stick pass.
